verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at support.elicit.com (HTTP 200) that indexes the help center. The help articles are served as Markdown (.md URLs), so an agent can ingest the docs directly, and there is agent-oriented setup documentation for the MCP server (e.g. the `claude mcp add` command). Missing for 10: no machine-readable API spec (all OpenAPI paths return 404), no root-level docs markdown index (the /en/.md path 404s), no evidence of an llms-full.txt, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
